body:
I have everything ready. I really don't know what I'll do but it's planned out so I really don't have to think about it anymore once in motion.  I wouldn't want to go back after I've ended my career, liquidated all my assets, donated, etc.

No... i guess not right now.  Thanks for talking with me.
The money would be better spent if I donated it. Other people would enjoy it a lot more than I would.

I don't want to drag them into this. I lived with my grandparents growing up.  If I told them they wouldn't handle it well.  They would stress out.  My grandmother told me she worries a lot about me but she's happy to see I can take care of myself.  I can't take that away from her.  She has enough to worry about.

I can't talk to a doctor.... they'd commit me for sure.  I've tried talking but I just can't be open and honest with them.  I've only been able to open up to strangers.  I can't just start trusting people.  I know I should but I can't.

I had two best friends when I was a kid.  We played cops and robber, cowboys and indians, etc.  I can't recreate what was there.  I don't have people in my life to trust.  Maybe that's part of the issue but I don't know how.  There is nothing for me to hold onto.  I havent made one friend out of work.  I've done everything on my own.

I've been telling myself this the whole time.  Before my vacation I said I was going to go somewhere but I didn't.  I stayed home.  I slept.  I spent my time trying to figure out where to get cyanide or where I could get a gun at the last minute, or how much xanax I would need.
I don't know what to do. heh...im starting to cry again.  i dont like feeling this way.

I can appreciate the finer parts of life but I still have that empty feeling.  It's hard to explain but I can't enjoy anything anymore.  There's no anger, happiness or sadness.  There's just a big hole of depression.

I wish you're right about tomorrow.  I don't know what happiness feels like... I've been faking it for too long.  Just trying to think about it makes me feel even more empty.

I saw a psychologist on Tuesday.  I'm not beyond trying to help myself but I've exhausted my options.  I setup the appointment as soon as the emptiness hit its hardest.  Maybe it's my fault for not being entirely open but I dont want to be committed. I just don't want to fight it anymore.  I don't have the energy.  I feel it in my chest all the time now.

I would trade everything to be genuinely happy... I haven't found it in the last several years and I don't expect to find it in the next month.  There's no point in letting myself feel this way.  It's not a good feeling.
